voice.hard-brake.note: Spoken cue at a brake point with a hard brake.

voice.light-brake.note: Spoken cue at a brake point with a light brake.

voice.ease-off.note: Spoken cue where the player lifts off the throttle.

voice.throttle.note: Spoken cue where the player opens the throttle.

voice.full-throttle.note: Spoken cue where the player opens the throttle fully.

voice.keep-left.note: Spoken cue when the car is to the right of the reference line.

voice.keep-right.note: Spoken cue when the car is to the left of the reference line.

voice.tighter.note: Spoken cue when the car is too far outside before the apex.

voice.big-stop.note: Spoken warning before a large brake zone.

voice.guidance-paused.note: Spoken when the cues stop because the car is far off the reference.

voice.guidance-resumed.note: Spoken when the cues start again.

voice.voice-check.note: Spoken by the voice test in Setup.

voice.focus-problem.approach-brake-early.text: Braking too early before the turn.
voice.focus-problem.approach-brake-early.note: Focus problem when the player brakes before the reference, before the turn-in. It follows the turn name.

voice.focus-problem.approach-brake-late.text: Braking too late before the turn.
voice.focus-problem.approach-brake-late.note: Focus problem when the player brakes after the reference, before the turn-in. It follows the turn name.

voice.focus-problem.approach-off-line.text: Off the line before the turn.
voice.focus-problem.approach-off-line.note: Focus problem when the player is away from the reference line and loses most time before the turn-in. It follows the turn name.

voice.focus-problem.approach.note: Focus problem when the player loses most time before the turn-in and no difference tells why. It follows the turn name.

voice.focus-problem.entry-slow.note: Focus problem when the speed of the player is too low between the turn-in and the apex. It follows the turn name.

voice.focus-problem.entry-fast.note: Focus problem when the lowest speed of the player is after the lowest speed of the reference. It follows the turn name.

voice.focus-problem.entry-wide-apex.text: Far from the apex on entry.
voice.focus-problem.entry-wide-apex.note: Focus problem when the player is far from the apex on the inside of the turn. It follows the turn name.

voice.focus-problem.entry-off-line.note: Focus problem when the player is away from the reference line and loses most time between the turn-in and the apex. It follows the turn name.

voice.focus-problem.entry.note: Focus problem when the player loses most time between the turn-in and the apex and no difference tells why. It follows the turn name.

voice.focus-problem.exit-throttle-late.text: Late on the throttle on exit.
voice.focus-problem.exit-throttle-late.note: Focus problem when the player opens the throttle after the reference, after the apex. It follows the turn name.

voice.focus-problem.exit-off-line.note: Focus problem when the player is away from the reference line and loses most time after the apex. It follows the turn name.

voice.focus-problem.exit.note: Focus problem when the player loses most time after the apex and no difference tells why. It follows the turn name.

voice.focus.note: Focus sentence after an attempt, spoken and shown. {turn} is the turn name, {problem} is the focus problem.

voice.brake-with-target.note: Shown text of a brake cue with its target speed, for example in the cue list. {action} is the brake cue, {speed} is the spoken speed with a capital letter.
